review.reason: The mapped layout, water, tees, greens, and main fairways are generally represented clearly, and the greens read as single natural putting surfaces. However, the short Hole 3 fairway patch lacks the required visible alternating mowing stripes.

issues.detail: The short curved fairway patch between T3 and G3 is uniformly pale green without clearly visible edge-to-edge alternating stripes.
issues.consequence: At thumbnail scale, this mapped fairway may read as an extra putting green or an unmarked patch rather than fairway.
